decisions.reason: Its promotion increased from a mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024, signaling added commitment and making management likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.
A dedicated page in both years and an explicit 2024 launch announcement make this a visible and publicly backed product that management is very unlikely to withdraw soon.
Its lower visibility suggests weaker traction, but it still fits the firm's modular electronics portfolio and escalation of commitment makes management likely to give the 2023 launch more time.
As a 2024 launch, it is still in the early evaluation phase, so management can readily attribute any weak uptake to a temporary ramp-up period and keep it on the market.

Although only mentioned on the site and somewhat less core than the hardware modules, it is a recent launch tied to a strategic digital service area, which encourages continued commitment for at least another year.
